description: Repairs r-par-1/err-where-evaluation-order: Errors was not cleared between statements. Asks which WHERE forms over ER raise the division error and at which call (open or GetRows(300)), and which rows come back: 1 / zm > 0; id < 50 AND 1 / zm > 0; 1 / zm > 0 AND id < 50; id < 50 OR 1 / zm > 0; id >= 150 AND 1 / zm > 0; id BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND 1 / zm > 0; IIf(id < 50, True, 1 / zm > 0); and the select-list expression with id < 50. A marker precedes the open and the GetRows of each statement and Errors follows each. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
